title: What percentage of companies globally will fulfill their pre-2026 cage-free commitments in 2026 and 2027?
resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as the percentage of global companies reporting in 2026 or 2027 that they have fulfilled the cage-free commitments they made before 2026 according to [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker) when accessed by Metaculus on January 1, 2028.
fine_print:
Specifically, the denominator will be obtained by selecting the "Cage-Free" issue on the [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker?filterK=Cage-free) progress tracker, a "Victory Date" of 1990 to 2025, and a "Timeline" of 2026 and after. The numerator will then be obtained by *additionally* selecting the "Reporting Fulfilled" status.

If Chicken Watch ceases reporting or significantly changes its criteria such that previous reporting is not comparable, this question will be **annulled**.
background: Eggs may be labelled as "cage-free" where the producing birds are kept out of battery cages. According to [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/cage-free), there is a worldwide trend toward improved animal welfare and cage-free produce is rapidly expanding. It [tracks companies globally](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker?filterK=Cage-free) on their commitments to eliminating cages from their operations and supply chains.
